description: Semantic search across all extracted datasheets. Finds components matching natural language queries about specifications, features, or capabilities. Best for broad spec-based discovery across all parts (e.g. 'low-noise LDO with PSRR above 70dB'). Only searches datasheets that have been previously extracted — not all parts that exist. For finding specific parts by number, use search_parts instead.

section_type.description: Optional: limit search to a specific section type
